tool.title: Transcribe audio — whisper.cpp (option, not installed)
tool.description: Transcribe an audio file to a timed transcript with whisper.cpp, offline, on CPU. A declared OPTION: not installed in this repository until the first audio upload.

install.cli: build whisper.cpp from source and download a ggml model (tiny ≈ 75 MB, base ≈ 142 MB)

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: The recording, under the declared `uploads` graph.

selection.when: The default candidate: offline, no Python, good accuracy from the tiny model up, and timestamps per segment — what a transcript that can be translated segment by segment needs.
selection.limits: A C++ build and a model file per container; weights are either vendored (repository size) or fetched at run time (a third-party host in the gate). Speaker labels are not included.
selection.cost: Not installed. Build ≈ 1–2 min; tiny model ≈ 75 MB. CPU transcription runs near real time for tiny, slower for larger models.
